changelog: Aura AI v2.4.10 — Real Scroll/Shorts/Reels Fix, Alarm & Video Seek/Like/Pause, Multi-App Voice Notification Reader, Smart Auto-Memory & Account Quota Reset

Fixed phone & short-video scrolling: 2-stage touch-slop + fling swipe curves, safe edge insets for Android 16/vivo, visible scrollable container ACTION_SCROLL fallback, expanded YouTube Shorts detection, and In-Built Browser background hijack prevention
Added set_alarm (alarm/timer/show alarms), verified Brightness readback fix, and STREAM_VOICE_CALL readback checks
Added +10s/-10s native YouTube seek (forward/rewind), cross-app Like (YouTube/Shorts/Reels/In-Built Browser), and reliable MediaSession + short-video Pause/Play controls
Upgraded AuraNotificationListenerService + Live Voice read-aloud for all messaging apps (WhatsApp, SMS, Telegram, Instagram, Messenger, Gmail) while Live Voice is active

Upgraded AuraMemoryManager across Voice & Text Chat with turn buffering, Hinglish/English rules, background Gemini Flash auto-extraction, topic-key/similarity deduplication, and save_memory/forget_memory tools
Fixed Account Logout -> New Login stale exhausted quotas & models across AGY, Codex, and Claude (clears caches, auto-switches off 0% models, and auto-restarts hub once if daemon stays stale)
